from solution import header_normalization
assert header_normalization('Content-Type,x-request-id')=='content-type,x-request-id'
assert header_normalization('X')=='x'
assert header_normalization('X,x') is None
assert header_normalization('x--y') is None
assert header_normalization('-x') is None
assert header_normalization('x_1') is None
